narr: A slow moving upper low generated multiple rounds of rain, some heavy, the night of January 29 into the morning of January 30 across North Texas. Much of the heavy rain and associated flooding occurred in and near the DFW Metroplex.
ev: A Twitter report was received with photos of cars stalled in floodwaters on Trinity Blvd, east of Hwy 360 near the Dallas/Tarrant County line.
The Shawnee bridge south of Bells Chapel Rd flooded between Red Oak and Pecan Hill, and the flood gates were closed at the road to deter drivers.
Broadcast media reported two people being swept away by flood waters and rescued on Wycliff Avenue between Oak Lawn and Highland Park.
Emergency management reported that both north and south bound lanes of the Interstate 35 access roads were closed due to flooding north of Highway 77 near Red Oak.
Highway 66 south of Highway 380 was flooded just southwest of Greenville. One vehicle was reported stranded. The report was received via social media.
A Facebook report and photos showed Highway 2642 flooded north of I-30 in Royse City.
Emergency management reported a water rescue at the 8200 block of FM 66 just south of Maypearl.
Emergency management reported the closure of Old Boyce Road, midway between Ennis and Waxahachie, due to flooding.
Emergency management reported a water rescue at the 900 block of Farrar Road, about 1.5 miles southeast of Rockett.
Emergency management reported the closure of Mosely Road between Garrett and Reagor Springs due to flooding.
Emergency management reported the closure of Dunkerly Road, between Garrett and Reagor Springs, due to flooding.
Emergency management reported a water rescue at the 5700 block of southbound I-45 service road in Garrett.
City of Fort Worth reported a high water rescue in the 7000 blk of Trimble Drive in south Fort Worth.
Trinity Blvd at Bear Creek became flooded in Shady Grove and was closed. A Grand Prairie alert rain gauge on the bridge measured 4.30 inches of rain in a short amount of time.
Broadcast media reported a high water rescue at the intersection of Goforth Road and Eagle Trail in northeast Dallas.
A National Weather Service employee reported several roads flooded near Hwy 360/183 area in Euless.
Emergency management reported a road closure at JC Spence Road east of Ennis.
Emergency management reported a road closure at Gin Rd east of Ennis.
Texas Department of Transportation reported that Highway 69 was closed just south of 380 due to high water on the northwest side of Greenville. One vehicle was reported stranded overnight.

Numerous roads remain flooded and closed across the city of Dallas including S. Ervay, S. Harwood, Illinois, Lamar, Teagarden, Ravenview, 2nd Ave, Southernland, Simpson Stuart, Farragut, Hatcher, Simpson Stuart, Inwood at Park, St. Johns Drive, Easton, Ferguson, Peavy at Dixon Dr, White Rock Trail, and Park Central.
Facebook report of cars stalled in floodwaters along Hwy 183 on the west side of Irving.
Emergency management reported that US 175 and FM 148 between Kaufman and Combine were closed multiple times for flooding through early morning.
Highway 1565 north of the Union Valley Fire Department and I-30 at Highway 1565 were both reported flooded per Union Valley Fire Dept on Facebook.
A National Weather Service employee reported that South Nursery Road at East Hunter Ferrell Road in Irving was impassable due to flooding.
Emergency management reported that a car was swept off the road by high water on County Road 2065 in Horton.
A high water rescue was conducted in the 8000 blk of CR 204 between Grandview and Auburn.

Royse City PD reported multiple flooded roadways in the city including FM 2642 by Verandah, Hwy 66 east of the police station, Crenshaw Road, FM 548 south of Waterscape, and Shaw Road between FM 2652 and FM 35.
Several roads were closed due to high water near the city of Cooper including FM 1529, FM 3388, and FM 1531.
Farm to Market 71 was closed due to high water in Birthright.

Multiple roads were flooded and closed across north Dallas including California Crossing, Wildwood Road, Luna Road, Tantor Road, Walnut Hill Road at Goodnight, Merriman Parkway, West Lawther at Northwest Hwy, Park Central at LBJ, and Goforth at Lanshire.
A high water rescue was reported on Farm to Market Road 71 southwest of Tira.
Several Farm to Market roads south of Paris were closed due to high water.

Law enforcement reported several roads flooded and closed in Garland including Campbell Rd at Water Oak Dr, E. Campbell Rd at Kinnertone Ln, Naaman Rd at E. Brand Rd, Naaman at E. Kingsbridge Dr, Castle Dr at Lost Pines Ln, and Castle Dr at Hickox Rd.
Several roads were flooded and closed in southern Dallas including S Harwood St, Bexar St, Illinois St, Lamar St, and Pemberton Hill.
The Dallas Sheriff's Office reported the I-30 eastbound service road at I-45/Highway 75 flooded and closed.
Emergency management reported a road closure at Walker Creek Road 4 miles north-northeast of Alma.
Emergency management reported a water rescue at the 700 block of Barton Road just northwest of Maypearl.
Broadcast media reported that Dallas Fire Rescue boats rescued six people from a flooded home on Fireside Drive.
Multiple reports of flooded roadways across Fort Worth were received including near S loop 820 and E Rosedale St.
